info.title: Minos.NET.Tool
info.description: The minos command line tool for Minos.NET: calibrates a decision model against a labelled dataset, builds the calibration report again from saved results, and checks that a provider conforms to the decision protocol.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Calibrates a decision model against a labelled dataset, checks that a provider conforms, exports recorded decisions as a labelled dataset, and compares a candidate with the primary on shadowed decisions.

commands.name: calibrate
commands.description: Runs a labelled dataset against a provider, then writes the results and a calibration report.

options.name: --dataset
options.description: The labelled dataset: a JSONL file with one item per line.

options.name: --config
options.description: The config file, JSON with a Minos section. Environment variables such as Minos__Providers__<name>__Model override it. [default: minos.json]

options.name: --provider
options.description: The provider section of the config to use. Default: the section named by Minos:Active.

options.name: --model
options.description: The model to call, in place of the section's Model. Default: the section's Model, then the provider's default model.

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many items run at once. [default: 1]

options.name: --prices
options.description: A prices file, JSON, that prices the tokens of a provider that reports no cost. Default: none, so only reported costs count.

options.name: --out
options.description: The directory for results.jsonl, report.json and report.md, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider section being run.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: conformance
commands.description: Sends the conformance probes to a live provider and checks its answers. Exits 1 when a check fails; a skipped check passes. The bad-key check is skipped when no API key is configured.

options.name: --config
options.description: The config file, JSON with a Minos section. Environment variables such as Minos__Providers__<name>__Model override it. [default: minos.json]

options.name: --provider
options.description: The provider section of the config to use. Default: the section named by Minos:Active.

options.name: --model
options.description: The model to call, in place of the section's Model. Default: the section's Model, then the provider's default model.

options.name: --out
options.description: The directory for conformance.json and conformance.md, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider section being checked.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: export
commands.description: Turns recorded decisions with confirmed outcomes into a labelled dataset and a signals file.

options.name: --records
options.description: The record file a recorder wrote: a JSONL file of decisions, outcomes and erasures.

options.name: --out
options.description: The directory for dataset.jsonl and dataset.signals.jsonl, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider export.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: report
commands.description: Builds the calibration report again from saved results and their dataset, without calling a provider.

options.name: --results
options.description: The results file a calibrate run saved, results.jsonl or results.partial.jsonl.

options.name: --dataset
options.description: The dataset the results were run on: a JSONL file.

options.name: --prices
options.description: A prices file, JSON, that prices the tokens of a provider that reports no cost. Default: none, so only reported costs count.

options.name: --out
options.description: The directory for report.json and report.md, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider named in the results header.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: shadow-report
commands.description: Compares the primary and the candidate of shadowed decisions: agreement, confusion tables and calibration against confirmed outcomes.

options.name: --records
options.description: The record file a recorder wrote: a JSONL file of decisions, outcomes and erasures.

options.name: --prices
options.description: A prices file, JSON, that prices the tokens of a provider that reports no cost. Default: none, so only reported costs count.

options.name: --out
options.description: The directory for shadow-report.json and shadow-report.md, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider shadow-report.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information
